title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: Calls for the EU and its Member States to combat Russian disinformation about the war, by fully restricting activities associated with Russian state-controlled media organisations and their contributors across EU Member States, extending relevant individual sanctions lists, pursuing legal accountability for those complicit in state-run propaganda, strengthening digital literacy, promoting fact-based information with special attention to countries specifically targeted by Russian propaganda outside Europe and holding social media platforms accountable for spreading harmful content by strictly enforcing the Digital Services Act[[5]](#footnote-5);
